name: @openwizard/system-01-intake
description: OpenWizard system 01: tenant-safe application intake and review.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --dir web exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --dir review-worker exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --config vitest.unit.config.ts && pnpm --dir web exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
